axis.labelEn: Two verses that come as one (do they teach?)

application.cueHe: שני כתובין הבאין כאחד אין מלמדין
application.evidenceEn: Rava reasons the Rabbis reject the gezera shava: the fifth-verses are two verses that come as one, and such verses do not teach elsewhere.

witnessText.text: אָמַר רָבָא: מִסְתַּבְּרָא לֵית לְהוּ גְּזֵירָה שָׁוָה, מִדְּגַלִּי רַחֲמָנָא חוֹמֶשׁ גַּבֵּי שְׂדֵה אֲחוּזָּה וְגַבֵּי מַקְדִּישׁ בֵּיתוֹ, הָווּ לֵיהּ שְׁנֵי כְּתוּבִין הַבָּאִין כְּאֶחָד, וְכׇל שְׁנֵי כְּתוּבִין הַבָּאִין כְּאֶחָד אֵין מְלַמְּדִין.

position.claim: the Rabbis reject the verbal analogy, so no fifth is added for a purchased field
position.basis: two, indeed many, verses that come as one do not teach

application.cueHe: וְכׇל שְׁנֵי כְּתוּבִין הַבָּאִין כְּאֶחָד אֵין מְלַמְּדִין
application.evidenceEn: The removal-of-ashes exception and the priestly vestments are two verses that come as one, and any two verses that come as one do not teach beyond themselves.

witnessText.text: מִשּׁוּם דְּהָוֵאי תְּרוּמַת הַדֶּשֶׁן וּבִגְדֵי כְהוּנָּה (שְׁנֵי כְּתוּבִין הַבָּאִין כְּאֶחָד), וְכׇל שְׁנֵי כְּתוּבִין הַבָּאִין כְּאֶחָד אֵין מְלַמְּדִין.

position.claim: nothing whose mitzva has been performed remains subject to misuse; the ash removal and the heifer are two verses that come as one and teach nothing beyond themselves
position.basis: text:ויקרא ו:ג and text:דברים כא:ו, each with its own restrictive term
